items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: No, T-bone wasn't in that band, in fact I didn't even know T-bone had played with Lionel Hampton.

ctx.x: No, I wanted to ask, by chance, was T-Bone (inaudible) joined the band then?

items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: benefit for T-Bone Walker at the musicians union here in Los Angeles... the great exponents of the blues, like T-Bone Walker and others are able to captivate audiences.

ctx.x: I've tested myself, in fact I do this as a game. I play a game with myself regularly, just no later than yesterday, benefit for T-Bone Walker at the musicians union here in Los Angeles, in Hollywood. I was testing my ability to do that, and I believe I have perfect pitch to the extent I can listen to anyone sing or play and
in a reasonable length of time I can tell which key they're in.
